name: Copps Hill Plaza
summary: Copps Hill Plaza is a high-traffic community shopping center serving affluent Ridgefield, Connecticut, anchored by the area's only supermarket. Professionally managed by Regency Centers, this essential neighborhood destination provides convenient access to quality retailers for the surrounding residential community.
demographics: Copps Hill Plaza serves the highly affluent Ridgefield community, one of Connecticut's wealthiest towns with median household incomes exceeding $150,000. The primary trade area consists of upper-income families and professionals, typically aged 35-65, residing in single-family homes. Shoppers are educated, quality-conscious consumers who prioritize convenience and premium products, with strong loyalty to the center's supermarket anchor as the only grocery option in the immediate area.
description: Copps Hill Plaza is a premier community shopping center located at 125 Danbury Road in the heart of Ridgefield, Connecticut, one of the state's most desirable communities. This high-traffic center serves as an essential retail hub for the affluent Ridgefield area, anchored by the only supermarket serving the immediate community, making it an indispensable destination for daily shopping needs. The plaza's strategic location along Danbury Road ensures excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding residential neighborhoods. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, Copps Hill Plaza benefits from professional management and a carefully curated tenant mix designed to serve the sophisticated needs of local residents. The center's strong performance is reflected in its 4.3-star rating from over 440 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and community appreciation for this vital neighborhood retail destination.
